Chhath Puja 2026 : bihar ke chhath ghaton par umra aastha ka sailab! | Sandhya Arghya in Patna
The grandeur of Chhath Puja, one of India's most sacred festivals, is being witnessed across the country. Devotees in Bihar, Jharkhand, Delhi, and other parts of India are celebrating this festival of faith and devotion by offering prayers to Chhathi Maiya and worshipping the Sun God.
Watch LIVE visuals from Chhath Ghats across the country, capturing the festive atmosphere, thousands of devotees, beautiful decorations, and the divine moments of Sandhya Arghya.
